summary: Verified KYC -> password-reset-email bug fix end-to-end. 8/8 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_kyc_password_reset_email.py. Covered: (1) startup re-schedule log 'Startup: re-scheduled auto-approve for N pending KYC submissions' (grepped from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at 10:32:28 with N=1), (2) EmailService singleton is configured after startup (api_key + sender_email set), (3) direct call to server._auto_approve_kyc(uid, 0) on freeze_type='both' user approves KYC + unfreezes + sets password_reset_token + password_reset_required=true + inserts email_log with subject 'Identity Verified - Reset Your Password - Zenthos' + email delivered by Resend (sent=True), (4) same behaviour for freeze_type='unusual_activity', (5) idempotent: second call is no-op (reviewed_at + token unchanged), disabled feature flag skips approval, (6) POST /api/admin/kyc/{uid}/review with status=approved sets password_reset_token + password_reset_required=true + inserts email_log + returns email_sent=true, (7) POST /api/auth/forgot-password sets token + inserts email_log with email_type='forgot_password', (8) unit test of the remaining-delay math (max(5, target_delay - elapsed)). E2E confirmation from real target user a8f5ec06-b843-4055-a5eb-9a9483fd9591 (agent_synced@test.com): after last server restart (10:32:28) startup re-scheduled its pending KYC and auto-approve fired ~5 min later — user is now kyc_status='approved', freeze_type='none', account_status='active', password_reset_required=true, password_reset_token set. HOWEVER the actual Resend delivery for that user's email failed with 'The eu-zenthos.com domain is not verified' — this is a CRITICAL data-config issue in DB, not a code bug (see backend_issues.critical below).

critical.issue: The DB doc {id:'system_settings'}.sender_email is 'noreply@eu-zenthos.com' (wrong domain — should be 'noreply@zenthos-eu.com'). Startup code at server.py L455-456 unconditionally overrides EmailService.sender_email with the DB value, so ALL live-server outgoing emails from Resend now fail with 'The eu-zenthos.com domain is not verified. Please, add and verify your domain on https://resend.com/domains'. This masks the bug fix at the delivery layer even though the KYC-approval code path executes correctly (email_log rows are inserted with sent=false, error='domain not verified'). Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at 10:37:26 for real user a8f5ec06 (agent_synced@test.com) AND at 10:37:34 / 10:39:01 for test users during pytest run against the live API. Direct-import tests in the pytest process succeed at delivery because they use SENDER_EMAIL from /app/backend/.env (noreply@zenthos-eu.com, verified) rather than the DB value.

minor.issue: Endpoint uses email.strip().lower() to query but stored emails may retain uppercase (e.g. TEST_ prefix). No functional issue for real users (register/login already lowercase), but for admin/agent-created accounts that store uppercase-prefixed emails this becomes a silent 200 with no email sent. Consider case-insensitive lookup ({'email': {'$regex': f'^{re.escape(email)}$', '$options': 'i'}}) or ensure all inserts .lower().

sender_email from DB unconditionally overrides EmailService.sender_email even when DB value is invalid/empty domain. Should validate the domain against a whitelist or at least log a warning if the loaded sender_email differs from env SENDER_EMAIL. Currently a single bad admin-settings save silently breaks all outgoing mail.

Uses `asyncio.create_task(_auto_approve_kyc(...))` without storing a strong reference; if the running loop is under memory pressure the task could be garbage-collected. Best-practice: keep a module-level set (_bg_tasks.add(task); task.add_done_callback(_bg_tasks.discard)).

Uses `datetime.fromisoformat(submitted_at)` at L474 — will raise ValueError on non-ISO strings, which is caught by the outer try/except and silently drops the reschedule. Consider logging the skipped user id + reason so we can spot corrupted rows.

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY: Fix the DB config typo — set db.system_settings.sender_email to 'noreply@zenthos-eu.com' (the verified Resend domain). Current DB value 'noreply@eu-zenthos.com' has hyphen in wrong place and Resend rejects it. Alternatively, delete the DB field so the .env SENDER_EMAIL takes effect via the fallback at server.py L77.
Validate sender_email on save (POST/PUT admin/settings) by rejecting values whose domain is not in a whitelist or by pinging Resend's domain-verified endpoint before persisting.
Consider case-insensitive email lookup in POST /api/auth/forgot-password.
(Optional) Track background asyncio tasks in a set to prevent GC of the re-scheduled auto-approve task.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:455-456 — silent unconditional override of EmailService.sender_email from DB is the root cause of the observed 'no email received' user complaint. Even after the code fix in this iteration, the delivery layer is broken due to bad DB data. Consider making the DB loader additive/validated rather than overriding.
server.py:1802-1811 — re-check of settings inside _auto_approve_kyc is good defensive design.

server.py:3160 — email send result is stored in email_log correctly (sent flag reflects Resend success), but the endpoint's `email_sent` field in the response only reflects the intended send, not the actual delivery outcome. Consider returning result.get('success') instead so admins get real feedback in the UI.

email_service.py:76-77 — EmailService reads env at __init__; combined with the singleton pattern this means changes to env after startup are ignored (fine) but the DB loader at server.py:455-456 mutates the singleton attributes directly. Prefer a factory that reconstructs the service when DB settings change (e.g. after admin edits settings).
server.py:1465-1466 — email lowercasing at query time only. All emails should be normalized at write time to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: test file creates TEST_KYC_<hex> users with lowercase test.zenthos.local emails and matching kyc_documents; all rows are removed in per-test finally blocks (users + kyc_documents + email_logs + audit_logs). No production data touched. system_settings.auto_approve_kyc is briefly toggled during idempotency test and restored to True.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix code (startup re-schedule + DB email settings loader) is CORRECT and verified by 8/8 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_kyc_password_reset_email.py. However, actual email delivery from the LIVE server is broken by a DB data typo: system_settings.sender_email='noreply@eu-zenthos.com' (invalid — Resend has zenthos-eu.com verified, not eu-zenthos.com). Confirmed in backend logs. The direct-import _auto_approve_kyc tests still pass because they re-init EmailService from .env (which has the correct sender_email). To retest after main agent fixes DB: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kyc_password_reset_email.py -v. Also consider adding a strict assertion `log.get('sent') is True` inside test_manual_admin_kyc_approve_sends_email (currently only asserts log exists) to catch this at CI time.

rca of the issue.code_bug_fixes: VERIFIED CORRECT. On server startup: (a) EmailService singleton loads Resend api_key + sender_email from db.system_settings when the singleton hasn't been configured from env (server.py:445-458); (b) any user still in kyc_status='pending' has _auto_approve_kyc re-scheduled with remaining_delay = max(5s, delay_minutes*60 - elapsed_since_submission) (server.py:460-485). When the delay elapses, _auto_approve_kyc approves KYC, flips freeze_type to 'none', activates the account, generates password_reset_token, sets password_reset_required=True, and enqueues an 'Identity Verified - Reset Your Password' email via Resend + logs it to email_logs.
rca of the issue.remaining_data_bug: The DB value db.system_settings.sender_email='noreply@eu-zenthos.com' is a typo (correct domain is 'zenthos-eu.com'). Since the startup email-settings loader at server.py:455-456 unconditionally overrides EmailService.sender_email from DB whenever DB has a value, the live server now sends from an unverified domain and Resend rejects every outbound email with 'The eu-zenthos.com domain is not verified.'. This is why the original user report (no reset email received) reproduces even after the code fix.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Ensure db.system_settings.sender_email='noreply@eu-zenthos.com'. 2) Restart backend. 3) sudo supervisorctl restart backend; sleep 2; tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — should show 'Startup: re-scheduled auto-approve for 1 pending KYC submissions'. 4) After ~5 min OR by calling _auto_approve_kyc(uid, 0) directly, observe user is approved and email_log row is inserted BUT sent=false with error='...eu-zenthos.com domain is not verified'.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Update DB: db.system_settings.updateOne({id:'system_settings'},{$set:{sender_email:'noreply@zenthos-eu.com'}}) OR $unset the field so the .env SENDER_EMAIL fallback kicks in. Then restart backend to reload EmailService.sender_email.
